aesthetics.typography: Open Sans throughout (rendered with a system sans fallback look): 14px titles, 12px status/meta, 10px tiny uppercase eyebrow and chip text
aesthetics.typeScale: Very flat scale: 14px regular row titles, 12px status/speed/timestamps in grey, 12px 500 chip labels, small uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow; no large headings

notes: VidBee: download manager UI. Amber/honey brand (bee logo) used for primary pill button, active nav tile (pale amber rounded square), progress bars (amber fill on pale amber track), selected-row highlight. Rows are borderless with gradient title-card thumbnails, brand-colored platform glyphs before titles, and right-aligned 32px circular icon buttons (copy path, pause/resume, cancel, download, retry). Status variants: spinner+percent+speed, Pending, paused, timestamp, red Error with full yt-dlp error text and report links, Cancelled. Untranslated i18n key 'history.cookiesTipAction' shows on the tip button. Bulk selection via hover checkbox on thumbnails, floating '1 selected' pill bottom-right.
